name: plan.yaml
rule: Minimal identified plan with declared contact, team, inactive section, and unanswered required suggested variable.

name: preparation.yaml
rule: Hand-specified complete preparation with preserved unknown root data.

name: record.yaml
rule: Record progress is independent from preparation and private answers are excluded from show.

name: empty-show.json
rule: Exact JSON shape before any record exists, with no inferred recipient values or progress.

name: full-show.json
rule: Exact separate preparation/progress projection with dates and outcome context preserved.
